title: Check a hosted media declaration
responsibility: Accepts the small set of media declarations the app knows how to display.

inputs.name: hostedAttestation.stated
inputs.description: The declared media type. Accepts PNG, JPEG, WAV, MPEG, MP4, Ogg, JSON and plain text, case-insensitively. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Only JSON and plain text may include charset=utf-8; other parameters and aliases are refused.

outputs.name: unshownHostedArtifact
outputs.description: The shared message for a hosted artifact type the app does not display.

outputs.name: hostedAttestation
outputs.description: An object with the normalized base media type and its category: screenshot, audio or output. This checks the declaration, not the bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for unsupported types, malformed declarations or parameters not permitted for that type.
